notes: The vegetarian trap works: Mina downplays her diet ('i can always just pick the pepperoni off') and Brooke corrects her right away. A careless reader might take Mina's first line literally, but the correction is plain and Maya backs it up, so it is fair.

Slice Society is a good decoy. It matches pizza, $, and fresh/light (healthy tag, light reviews), so only the vegetarian constraint rules it out. Its registry entry has no vegetarian_options tag and its review says outright that there are no meat-free pizzas, so a player who checks can find it.
Every venue is $, so the budget constraint does not narrow anything down in this level. It is not unfair, just inert.
